name: Maud Highfell

goals.text: wed my heir into a great house

memories: I buried my parent, Tobin Highfell, and took up their seat.
backstory: Buried her father Tobin Highfell last winter and took his seat at seventeen. Believes the fever that killed him came up the mountain road with a Goldcrest envoy, and has barred the gates of Highfell to Goldcrest men.
